output.title: AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats promoted to GA in v1.18.0
output.content: The operator's environment includes cert-manager v1.17.0 with active Certificate resources (cert-manager.io/v1 CRD in use). The upstream change promotes `AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats` from a feature flag to GA, making additional formats always enabled. Since this is a feature promotion affecting certificate output, it may impact how certificates are formatted or exposed in the upgraded environment. Inspect: whether any downstream systems depend on specific certificate output formats, and review v1.18.0 release notes for what "additional formats" means and whether the behavior change requires configuration adjustments.
